text:
- Find a starting point on Home and jump to sections of the Modern Timeline.
- Read Secret Wars and World War Hulk by issue or book. Follow Civil War to Secret Invasion in 14 parts, plus Standoff, Civil War II, both Secret Empire guides, Empyre and Blood Hunt.
- Use Read for a verified link or Find on Marvel Comics to search.
- Keep a complete backup before upgrading. Version 4.8.0 cannot restore new complete backups containing comics with the new reading-link or search-only details.
